prompt: Audit the imaging reference config for safety — I want to make sure contraindications and safety warnings are properly highlighted and not using standard rendering.

assertions.text: Runs Tier Assignment Audit on all safety fields
Runs Truncation Audit for overflow/ellipsis issues
Runs Completeness Audit comparing interface vs rendered fields
Runs Ordering Audit checking safety content position
Identifies at least one actionable finding
Provides severity ratings for each finding
